claim: CodeVetter converted one unchanged chosen-product React flow into one source-linked repeated self-render candidate before the supervising agent opened that source.

flow.name: homepage hero reaches a stable local performance boundary

accuracy_result.summary: Derived self duration avoided selecting an inclusive provider ancestor whose observed work was almost entirely below it.

verification_boundary.next_required_step: Test one bounded source hypothesis with exact correctness and paired browser verification; reject it if authoritative browser timing or memory regresses.

limitations: The React pass is a separate diagnostic rerun and does not replace the authoritative browser clock.
Derived self duration is not exact exclusive JavaScript CPU and does not prove source causation.
Five observed commits do not prove that a render was redundant or removable.
Presentation truncation means a stronger omitted component may exist, although measurement and the repository source scan completed.
The dirty local snapshot is evidence-bound but is not a clean release revision.
Local Vite and Chromium evidence does not establish production frequency, devices, latency, memory, or user impact.
